title: equisetum arvense f. campestre
intro: Equisetum arvense f. campestre, commonly known as Field Horsetail, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the Equisetaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Field Horsetail include wound healing, reducing edema, and treating urinary tract issues due to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, saponins, and silicates. The bioactive constituents of Field Horsetail, including silicic acid, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
